title: cynoglossum cheirifolium subsp. heterocarpum
intro: Cynoglossum cheirifolium subsp. heterocarpum, commonly known as Heterocarpous Hound's Tongue, is a perennial plant that belongs to the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Heterocarpous Hound's Tongue include its ability to reduce inflammation, treat respiratory issues, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. Its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
